Crucial 8GB DDR5 5600MHz CL46 Laptop Memory (SODIMM)

Experience the next-generation performance leap for your modern notebook with the ultra-fast Crucial 8GB DDR5 5600MHz Laptop Memory. Available at Turbo Computer, this high-density SODIMM hardware upgrade delivers nearly 1.75x the data rates of standard DDR4, providing blazingly fast frequencies right out of the box. It stands as the definitive choice for professionals, gamers, and multitasking users across Egypt looking for a seamless, reliable hardware modification to optimize system configurations and daily performance tracking.

Expertly engineered powered by Micron quality, the Crucial DDR5 laptop module operates at a blistering 5600MHz with an efficient low-voltage design of 1.1V for enhanced power management and reduced thermal footprint. It features on-module voltage regulation (PMIC) and on-die ECC (Error Correction Code) to guarantee rock-solid system stability and improved bandwidth execution, unlocking an elevated multi-core processing ecosystem.
